ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能规划最优铺瓦方案，但屋顶上那卷被太阳晒软的卷材，还是得靠帮工和师傅的手一起铺平。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年帮工屋顶工在岗约 0.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.55 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.06 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代帮工屋顶工，这个岗位短期非常安全。高空、多变、非标的作业环境让机器人和自动化渗透极慢，AI 顶多能优化排料、天气预报和施工排程。真正被改变的，是行业对「纯苦力」的依赖会下降——会手艺、懂工序的帮工更容易升级成独立屋顶工。
ai_s2_accel: 无人机航拍辅助屋顶勘察与测量
BIM 三维模型指导屋面施工
AI 检测屋面老化与渗漏隐患
机器人铺瓦进入早期试验
ai_s2_auto: 施工排程与天气预报由 App 自动推送
材料用量计算由软件辅助
订单与报价管理电子化
现场拍照记录自动归档
ai_s3_list: 高空作业的平衡与胆量：坡屋面上行走、作业，机器进不来。
现场配合的默契：师傅一个手势，帮工知道递什么、挪什么。
手工工艺的学习：卷材焊接、瓦片收边，这些手艺靠日积月累。
天气与现场的应变：突然起风、骤雨，收尾、遮盖都要人判断。
安全习惯的养成：挂绳、防滑、工具固定，是保命的功夫。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的桌面事务有限——排程、算料、记录，这些正被软件优化。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。屋顶工程的环境决定了自动化渗透极慢，真正的变化在行业内部：会手艺、懂工序的帮工更容易升级为独立屋顶工，纯苦力型帮工的空间在收窄。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不想走学历路线，可走技校建筑类专业或直接学徒。屋顶工是越老越值钱的手艺活，前提是愿意吃苦、不恐高，把安全当第一课。
别满足于「递料打下手」，主动学卷材焊接、瓦片铺设和排水收边，考防水工技能证。从帮工变师傅，收入和安全系数都会上一个台阶。
能吃苦、不恐高就可以入行，劳务市场或工头带班是最快渠道。上手后尽快学手艺和考证书，别把帮工当终点。
招帮工别只看「有把力气」，要看安全意识和学艺意愿。愿意学、守规矩的帮工两年就能顶半个师傅，比频繁换人的纯苦力更划算。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 高空测量、面积计算、隐患识别
排程、天气推送、进度拍照
屋面构造可视化、材料算量

ai_s7_trends: 机器人铺瓦与 AI 勘察进入早期试验，但屋顶工程非标、多变的环境决定了未来五年仍以人工作业为主。
老建筑翻新与极端天气维修需求支撑行业，会手艺、懂工序的屋顶工溢价上升。
安全监管与持证要求趋严，无证纯苦力帮工的空间收窄，技能化转型成为出路。

body: 帮工屋顶工是屋顶工团队中的辅助岗位，负责屋面施工中的材料搬运、旧屋面拆除、工具准备与现场清理，在师傅指导下参与卷材、瓦片的辅助铺设。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能规划最优铺瓦方案，但屋顶上那卷被太阳晒软的卷材，还是得靠帮工和师傅的手一起铺平。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can document a case in two minutes and flag drug interactions, but the physician on duty must decide whether a patient whose oxygen level drops at 2 a.m. needs intensive care.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 340,700 resident physicians on the job in 2024, and the number is expected to rise to 349,300 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 8,600 positions, an average of approximately 9,600 vacancies per year, and a median annual salary of ≥$239,200 in 2024 (BLS OES Top Grade, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace hospitalists, but it will reshape their work. It can accelerate documentation, order entry, preliminary image review, and literature searches, leaving physicians more time for rounds and communication. Diagnosis, treatment choices, assessment of disease progression, and patient trust remain human responsibilities.
ai_s2_accel: AI disease deterioration prediction and early warning
Diagnosis and treatment decision-making assistance and program suggestions
Intelligent ward round list and quality control reminder
Automation of discharge and follow-up management
ai_s2_auto: AI-assisted medical record writing and voice entry
Automatic prompts for medical orders and drug interactions
AI first reading of images and inspection reports
Literature search and instant guide recommendation
ai_s3_list: Clinical decision-making: When the combination of symptoms is complex, dare to make a decision or stop.
Disease prediction: Read risks from subtle changes and take action one step ahead.
Doctor-patient communication: Use professional terminology in adult language so that family members can cooperate with peace of mind.
Team coordination: nurses, technicians, specialist consultations, relying on people to connect in series.
Emergency response: Emergency rescue in the middle of the night relies on experience and calmness.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10, moderate AI exposure score reflects extensive automation of documentation and retrieval. Core responsibilities such as rounds, diagnosis, treatment decisions, and communication still require a physician's judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: AI can help doctors relieve the burden of paperwork, but it is an opportunity for the industry to "reduce" the burden. What we really need to be wary of is the inert thinking that treats AI results as conclusions; treating AI as a second opinion and an efficiency tool, clinical judgment and communication skills are still irreplaceable moats.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To study medicine, one must be mentally prepared for "long investment and slow return": undergraduate studies plus regular training should start at least eight years ago. Think clearly about whether you can withstand high intensity and night shifts; studying medicine in the AI ​​era requires more attention to clinical thinking and communication training. These are core abilities beyond examinations.

Use AI tools to reduce the paperwork burden and spend time on difficult cases and communication between doctors and patients. By delving deeper into subspecialties (critical care, cardiology, respiratory, etc.), the composite value of resident physicians will become higher and higher.

It is basically impossible to transfer non-clinical majors to residents, but medical assistance, nursing, and medical informatization can cut into the clinical ecology. Those with a nursing or medical technology background can first work in department coordination or medical record management positions.

The main reasons for the loss of resident doctors are intensity and burnout. It is recommended to use "reasonable scheduling + information-based burden reduction + professional title channel" to retain them. When purchasing AI tools, priority should be given to those that can reduce paperwork and return doctors’ time to patients.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Medical record writing and medical order management
Automatic transcription of ward round dictation
Initial image reading and lesion annotation
Ward round key points and quality control reminders

ai_s7_trends: The trend of specialization of resident doctors continues, and the demand for hospitalization due to aging and chronic diseases drives the expansion of positions.
With the popularization of AI documentation and decision-making assistance, the focus of resident doctors' work has returned to ward rounds, communication and critical illness management.
Subspecialty and team-based diagnosis and treatment have been deepened, and the collaborative model between resident doctors, medical assistants, and nurses has matured.

body: Resident physicians are physicians who are responsible for the diagnosis and treatment of inpatients. They manage the entire medical diagnosis and treatment of patients during their stay in the hospital, from admission assessment, daily ward rounds, treatment plan formulation and adjustment, to discharge guidance and in-hospital coordination.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can document a case in two minutes and flag drug interactions, but the physician on duty must decide whether a patient whose oxygen level drops at 2 a.m. needs intensive care.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能两分钟写完病程、自动提示药物相互作用，但半夜 2 点那个血氧往下掉的病人该不该转 ICU——这个决定，得由值班医生用经验来扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年住院医师在岗约 34.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 34.93 万人，净增约 0.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.96 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代住院医师，但会改变工作形态。病历书写、医嘱录入、影像初读、文献检索正被 AI 大幅替代，医师省下的时间可以更多用在查房和沟通上。诊断决策、治疗取舍、病情恶化的预判和医患信任，依然是 AI 无法交付的核心。
ai_s2_accel: AI 病情恶化预测与早期预警
诊疗决策辅助与方案建议
智能查房清单与质控提醒
出院与随访管理自动化
ai_s2_auto: AI 辅助病历书写与语音录入
医嘱开具与药物相互作用自动提示
影像与检验报告的 AI 初读
文献检索与指南即时推荐
ai_s3_list: 临床决策：症状组合复杂时，敢拍板也敢停。
病情预判：从细微变化读出风险，提前一步行动。
医患沟通：把专业术语讲成人话，让家属安心配合。
团队协调：护士、技师、专科会诊，靠人串联。
应急处置：半夜的突发抢救，靠的是经验和冷静。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明住院医师的「文书与检索」环节 AI 参与度高，但这些是辅助——核心的查房、诊断、治疗决策和沟通，AI 只能当工具，不能当决策者。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：AI 帮医师卸下文书重担，反而是行业「减负」的机会。真正要警惕的是把 AI 结果当结论的惰性思维；把 AI 当第二意见、当效率工具，临床判断力和沟通能力仍然是不可替代的护城河。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学医要有「长投入、慢回报」的心理准备：本科加规培至少八年起步。想清楚是否扛得住高强度与夜班；AI 时代学医更要重视临床思维和沟通训练，这些是考试之外的核心能力。
把 AI 工具用起来减轻文书负担，把时间花在疑难病例和医患沟通上。往亚专科深耕（重症、心内、呼吸等），住院医师的复合价值会越来越高。
非临床专业转住院医师基本走不通，但医助、护理、医疗信息化方向可以切入临床生态。有护理或医技背景的，可以先做科室协调或病历管理岗。
住院医师流失主因是强度与倦怠，建议用「合理排班 + 信息化减负 + 职称通道」留人。AI 工具采购应优先选能减文书的，把医师时间还给病人。

ai_s7_trends: 住院医师专职化趋势延续，老龄化与慢病住院需求推动岗位扩张。
AI 文书与决策辅助普及，住院医师工作重心向查房、沟通和重症管理回归。
亚专科化与团队化诊疗深化，住院医师与医助、护士的协同模式成熟。

body: 住院医师是专职负责住院患者诊疗的医师，从入院评估、日常查房、治疗方案制定与调整，到出院指导和院内协调，全程管理患者在院期间的内科诊疗事务。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能两分钟写完病程、自动提示药物相互作用，但半夜 2 点那个血氧往下掉的病人该不该转 ICU——这个决定，得由值班医生用经验来扛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Machines can wash standard items, but workers still decide how to treat each fabric and remove stains.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 202,600 laundry and dry-cleaning workers employed in 2024, projected to reach 213,500 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 10,900 jobs, with roughly 31,900 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $33,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace laundry workers, but it will reduce standard tasks. Automated washing and sorting accelerate routine work, shifting workers from repeated washing toward fabric identification, stain removal, and delicate care. Standard-only washing roles face pressure, while people skilled in stain removal and fabric care become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Fabric identification: people rely on touch.
Stain removal: people apply experience.
Delicate care: people make tradeoffs.
Quality control: people apply a trained eye.
Client communication: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score places this occupation at low AI exposure. Washing, care, and sorting become faster, while stain removal and fabric protection still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Automation replaces standard washing tasks, not stain-removal and garment-care roles. Premium service makes people with fabric-care skills scarcer, while standard-only washing workers face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start as an apprentice and practice stain removal and fabric knowledge. Pure washing work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop craft skills early.
Advance from washing to stain removal plus garment care, and learn to identify fabrics.
Emphasize tactile judgment and attention to detail, clearly identifying the garment categories you have handled.
Do not hire for speed alone. Look for stain-removal skill; core workers merit higher piece rates.

ai_s7_trends: Automated garment care becomes widespread.
Demand for premium garment care increases.
Stain-removal skills become more sought after.

body: Laundry and dry-cleaning workers sort garments by fabric, operate laundry and dry-cleaning equipment, remove stains, and press items while protecting cleanliness and garment condition.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Machines can wash standard items, but workers still decide how to treat each fabric and remove stains.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器能洗标准件，但什么面料、怎么去渍，还是工人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人在岗约 20.26 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 21.35 万人，净增约 1.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.19 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.38 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代洗衣工，但会压缩标准环节。自动洗涤与分拣把常规提速，工作从「反复洗」挪向「辨面料、去渍、精细护理」。真正被挤掉的是只洗标准件的人，会去渍会护面料的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 辨面料：手感靠人。
去渍：经验靠人。
精细护理：取舍靠人。
质检把关：眼力靠人。
客户沟通：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——洗护与分拣被加速，但去渍与护面料仍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「标准洗护」动作，不是「去渍与护理」的岗位。会去渍会护面料的人，反而随精品更稀缺。怕的是只会洗标准件。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学徒起步多练去渍与面料，AI 时代纯洗护在缩，早点练手艺。
从「洗护」升级成「去渍 + 护理」，学面料识别。
突出手感与细心，写清跟过哪些品类。
选人别只看快，要看会不会去渍。骨干值得给高件工。

ai_s7_trends: 自动洗护普及。
精品护理需求增。
会去渍更抢手。

body: 洗衣与干洗工按面料分拣衣物，操作洗涤与干洗设备完成洗护、去渍与熨烫，保障清洁度与衣物完好。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 机器能洗标准件，但什么面料、怎么去渍，还是工人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Scheduling can run automatically, but projectionists still decide which screening needs inspection and how to handle emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 2,000 motion picture projectionists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to remain at about 2,000 by 2034, a net change of about 0 jobs, with approximately 500 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $38,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace motion picture projectionists, but it will reduce scheduling work. Digital projection and automated scheduling accelerate routine tasks, shifting the job from manual scheduling toward on-site inspection, emergency response, and support for multiple auditoriums. People who only follow schedules face displacement, while those who can inspect systems and respond to problems are more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-site inspection: people assess actual conditions.
Emergency response requires human tradeoffs.
Audio and video quality control: depends on human eyes and ears.
Multi-auditorium coordination: depends on human collaboration.
Responsibility for the experience: depends on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Scheduling and calibration are accelerated, but inspection and response still preserve a role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Following a screening schedule is being replaced, not inspection and emergency-response roles. As multiplexes grow, people who can inspect systems and respond to problems become scarcer. Those who only follow schedules face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting at a cinema, practice equipment operation and inspection. Pure scheduling work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop troubleshooting skills early.
Advance from scheduling to inspection and emergency response, and learn digital projection.
Highlight your training and attention to detail, and specify which auditoriums you have supported.
When hiring, look beyond a quiet demeanor and assess the ability to handle emergencies. Core staff deserve responsibility for the projection booth.

ai_s7_trends: Digital projection is widespread.
Demand for multiplex support is growing.
People who can handle incidents are more sought after.

body: Motion Picture Projectionists operate digital projection systems, verify media and timecodes, calibrate light, audio, and video, ensure every screening is clear, stable, and synchronized, and handle on-site incidents.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Scheduling can run automatically, but projectionists still decide which screening needs inspection and how to handle emergencies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排片能自动跑，但哪场该巡检、怎么处置突发，还是放映员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电影放映员在岗约 0.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.20 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.82 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电影放映员，但会压缩排片环节。数字放映与自动排片把常规提速，工作从「手动排」挪向「现场巡检、突发处置、多厅保障」。真正被挤掉的是只按排片的人，会巡检会处置的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场巡检：实况靠人。
突发处置：取舍靠人。
声画把关：耳眼靠人。
多厅协调：配合靠人。
体验负责：责任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——排片与校准被加速，但巡检与处置还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「按排片放映」动作，不是「巡检与突发处置」的岗位。会巡检会处置的人，反而随多厅更稀缺。怕的是只会按排片。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 影院起步多练设备与巡检，AI 时代纯排片在缩，早点练处置。
从「排片」升级成「巡检 + 处置」，学数字放映。
突出培训与细心，写清跟过哪些厅。
选人别只看安静，要看会不会处置突发。骨干值得给机房。

ai_s7_trends: 数字放映普及。
多厅需求增。
会处置的人更抢手。

body: 电影放映员操作数字放映系统，核片源对时间码、校准光与声画，保障每场放映清晰稳定同步，并处置现场突发。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 排片能自动跑，但哪场该巡检、怎么处置突发，还是放映员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help arrange music, generate accompaniment, correct pitch, and even create a complete single, but only a living musician can deliver the emotion and presence that gives an audience goosebumps.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 169,800 Musicians And Singers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 171,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,800 jobs, with approximately 19,400 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $99,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Musicians And Singers, but it will fundamentally change the cost structure of music production. AI arranging, accompaniment generation, pitch correction, and mixing make producing a song inexpensive, reducing pure production roles. What remains is live performance, personal expression through creation, and the ability to release content consistently. Musicians who can sing, perform, and build a personal brand will benefit.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted inspiration for songwriting and composition
One-click music generation for short videos
Wider adoption of live-stream audio effects and interaction tools
ai_s3_list: Live presence: make the audience respond.
Personal distinctiveness: be remembered for your voice and style.
Emotional expression: sing feelings that machines cannot simulate.
Stage adaptability: recover from wrong notes, forgotten lyrics, and equipment failures.
Brand management: release content consistently and connect with listeners.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means music is a moderate-high exposure creative industry. AI can arrange, accompany, correct pitch, and mix, greatly lowering the barrier to music production. Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Audiences listen for human character, and AI cannot replace live performance, emotional expression, or personal distinctiveness. Leading and live performers are becoming scarcer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure means production is no longer the barrier; content and audience development are. Use AI to reduce production costs and focus on refining the work, performing live, and building an audience. In an era of exploding supply, musicians with a distinctive identity and consistent output are among the few who will be noticed.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Children pursuing music must accept high investment and uncertain outcomes. Professional study is reasonable, but they should also learn audience development and content creation rather than rely on a single path. Let genuinely interested children perform and compete often to test whether their passion and persistence are real.

Use AI production tools to lower costs and spend more time on live performance and content. Build a catalog and platform accounts, release consistently, and become a versatile artist who can sing, create content, and perform live.

People without professional training can also start on platforms. Build an audience with covers and music short videos, then gradually release original work. When seeking performances or collaborations, bring platform data and a portfolio instead of talking only about dreams. AI tools substantially lower startup costs.

Labels and performance organizations should provide musicians with production and audience-development resources, not only revenue-share contracts. Combine live and content talent, because artists who can perform and manage an audience have greater commercial value in the AI era.

ai_s7_trends: AI sharply lowers barriers to music production, causing content supply to surge and distinctiveness to become scarce.
Live performances and music festivals are recovering, favoring musicians with strong stage presence.
Direct platform distribution and personal brands are becoming standard, benefiting musicians who can manage their audience.

body: Musicians And Singers perform and create music through singing, playing instruments, or composing. They participate in recordings and live performances and use digital platforms to release work, maintain audiences and personal brands, and make music their core profession.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can help arrange music, generate accompaniment, correct pitch, and even create a complete single, but only a living musician can deliver the emotion and presence that gives an audience goosebumps.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你编曲、伴奏、修音，甚至生成完整单曲，但「唱到让人起鸡皮疙瘩那一下」——现场的情感和表现力，只有活生生的音乐人给得了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年音乐家与歌手在岗约 16.98 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.16 万人，净增约 0.18 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.94 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.94 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代音乐家与歌手，但会彻底改变音乐生产的成本结构：AI 编曲、伴奏生成、修音混音让「做出一首歌」变得便宜，纯制作型岗位被压缩。真正留下的是现场表现力、创作的个人表达和持续输出内容的能力——会唱、会演、会做个人品牌的音乐人反而受益。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助词曲创作灵感生成
虚拟歌手与数字分身演出
直播音效与互动工具普及
ai_s3_list: 现场表现力：让台下观众有反应。
个人辨识度：声音与风格让人记住。
情感表达：唱出机器模拟不出的情绪。
舞台应变：跑调、忘词、设备故障的救场。
品牌经营：持续输出内容与听众连接。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明音乐行业属于「中高曝光」的创作行业：编曲、伴奏、修音、混音都能被 AI 完成，音乐生产的门槛大幅下降。但中高曝光不等于高风险——听众听的是「人味儿」，现场演出、情感表达、个人辨识度，AI 替代不了，头部和现场型音乐人反而更稀缺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着制作不再是壁垒，内容与运营才是：用 AI 把制作成本打下来，把精力放在打磨作品质感、做现场、经营听众上。在 AI 让供给暴涨的时代，有辨识度和持续输出能力的音乐人，是少数会被看见的那批。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子想走音乐，要接受「投入高、出路不确定」：专业学习可以，但建议同时学运营和内容创作，别把鸡蛋放一个篮子里。真有兴趣的先让孩子多参加演出和比赛，看是否真的有热爱和坚持。
把 AI 制作工具用起来降低成本，把时间花在现场和内容上；建立自己的作品库和平台账号，稳定输出，往「会唱 + 会做内容 + 有现场」的复合型艺人方向走。
非专业出身也能靠平台起步：先翻唱、做音乐短视频积累，再逐步发原创；面试演出或合作时带上你的平台数据和作品，比只谈梦想有用，AI 工具会大大降低你的起步成本。
厂牌和演出机构要留住人，建议给音乐人配制作与运营资源，别只签分成；同时重视现场型人才和内容型人才的组合，AI 时代「能演出 + 能运营」的艺人更有商业价值。

ai_s7_trends: AI 让音乐制作门槛大降，内容供给爆发，辨识度成为稀缺。
线下演出与音乐节回暖，现场型音乐人更吃香。
平台直发与个人 IP 成为主流，会运营的音乐人受益。

body: 音乐家与歌手通过演唱、演奏或作曲进行音乐表演与创作，参与录音与现场演出，并利用数字平台发布作品、维护听众与个人品牌，以音乐作为核心职业。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你编曲、伴奏、修音，甚至生成完整单曲，但「唱到让人起鸡皮疙瘩那一下」——现场的情感和表现力，只有活生生的音乐人给得了。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can reconstruct images with one click and automatically draft reports, but the three seconds spent verifying a dose before injection and a patient's cough during positioning are details that determine image quality and diagnostic accuracy. People still have to watch them.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 20,000 Nuclear Medicine Technologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 20,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 600 jobs, with approximately 900 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $97,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Nuclear Medicine Technologists, but it will take over image reconstruction, report drafting, scheduling, and registration. Tracer management, patient positioning, image quality control, and radiation safety remain the technologist's core responsibilities.
ai_s3_list: Dose and protocol execution: tracer verification and injection dosage must be correct at every step.
Positioning and patient communication: positioning accuracy and patient cooperation directly determine the image.
Radiation safety habits: protective measures are daily habits, not merely procedures.
Image quality judgment: technologists provide the first assessment of whether reconstructed images are adequate.
Equipment anomaly recognition: immediately detect drifting machine parameters and image artifacts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means image reconstruction, reporting, and recordkeeping account for a substantial share of this occupation and are being taken over by AI. Tracer handling, positioning, and radiation safety remain the human domain, leaving limited scope for replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high risk does not mean unemployment. AI takes over image processing and documentation, including reconstruction and initial screening, while people still perform injections, positioning, and quality control. Technologists skilled in equipment quality control and multimodal imaging become more valuable as AI improves efficiency.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study medical imaging technology or nuclear medicine, build strong knowledge of imaging anatomy and equipment principles, and obtain professional credentials early. In the AI era, learn multimodal imaging and equipment quality control, which remain core human skills.

Become proficient with AI reconstruction and reporting tools and invest the saved time in image quality control and equipment management. Progress toward supervisory technologist, equipment quality control, or teaching roles rather than stopping at positioning and scanning.

A medical imaging technology background and professional credential are required; there is no shortcut. You can begin as a technologist assistant, but certification is a firm barrier. Before changing careers, confirm that you can accept radiation environments and strict protocols.

When hiring Nuclear Medicine Technologists, test protocol compliance before operational skill. Candidates with the wrong attitude toward dose verification and radiation protection are unsuitable. Provide complete AI-assisted tools and focus people on positioning, quality control, and patient communication to substantially improve examination quality.

ai_s7_trends: As AI image reconstruction and denoising spread, technologists are shifting toward quality control and patient communication.
Oncology diagnosis and treatment are driving growth in PET-CT demand and expansion of Nuclear Medicine Technologist positions.
Multimodal imaging and intelligent equipment upgrades favor technologists with combined skills.

body: Under the guidance of nuclear medicine physicians, Nuclear Medicine Technologists prepare and inject radiopharmaceuticals known as tracers, operate SPECT/PET and similar scanners, reconstruct and process images, and implement radiation safety and quality control.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can reconstruct images with one click and automatically draft reports, but the three seconds spent verifying a dose before injection and a patient's cough during positioning are details that determine image quality and diagnostic accuracy. People still have to watch them.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一键重建图像、自动打报告初稿，但给病人注射前那三秒钟的剂量核对、摆位时病人的一声咳嗽，这些细节决定图像质量，也决定诊断准确性——这活还得人盯着。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年核医学技师在岗约 2.00 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.06 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.70 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代核医学技师，但会接管图像重建、报告初稿和排班登记。示踪剂管理、病人摆位、图像质量把关与辐射安全，仍是技师的核心职责。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助图像质量评估
低剂量成像 AI 降噪
ai_s2_auto: 图像重建与后处理 AI 化
排班与检查登记数字化
ai_s3_list: 剂量与规程执行：示踪剂核对、注射剂量，一步都不能错。
摆位与病人沟通：体位准不准、病人配合不配合，直接决定图像。
辐射安全习惯：防护措施是习惯不是流程，日日如此。
图像质量判断：重建出来的图好不好，技师要有第一关判断。
设备异常识别：机器参数飘了、图像有伪影，第一时间发现。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的图像重建、报告、记录比重不低，这些正被 AI 接管；但示踪剂操作、摆位与辐射安全是人的主战场，AI 替代空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高风险不等于失业。AI 抢的是「图像处理和文书」——重建、初筛交给 AI，注射、摆位、质控还得靠人。会设备质控、懂多模态影像的技师，反而因 AI 提效而更吃香。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选医学影像技术或核医学专业，把影像解剖、设备原理学扎实，执业资格尽早考。AI 时代把多模态影像、设备质控学起来，这些是 AI 替不了的核心。
把 AI 重建与报告工具用熟，把省下的时间投入图像质控与设备管理。往主管技师、设备质控、教学方向走，别让技能停在摆位扫描。
需要医学影像技术专业背景与执业资格，没有捷径。可从技师助理起步，但职业证书是硬门槛；转行前先确认自己能接受辐射环境与严格规程。
招核医学技师先考规程执行再考操作——剂量核对与辐射防护态度不对的不能要。配齐 AI 辅助工具，把人手用在摆位、质控与病人沟通上，检查质量会明显提升。

ai_s7_trends: AI 图像重建与降噪普及，技师重心转向质控与病人沟通。
肿瘤诊疗带动 PET-CT 需求增长，核医学技师岗位扩招。
多模态影像与设备智能化升级，复合技能技师更吃香。

body: 核医学技师在核医学医师指导下，负责放射性药物（示踪剂）的准备与注射、SPECT/PET 等设备的扫描操作、图像重建与处理，并执行辐射安全防护与质量控制。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一键重建图像、自动打报告初稿，但给病人注射前那三秒钟的剂量核对、摆位时病人的一声咳嗽，这些细节决定图像质量，也决定诊断准确性——这活还得人盯着。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Rehabilitation robots can assist movement practice, but assistants still support patients through emotional setbacks and repetition and adapt training to each person.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 49,200 occupational therapy assistants employed in 2024, projected to rise to 58,700 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 9,500 jobs, with roughly 7,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $68,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace occupational therapy assistants; it will only help with records and assessments. Rehabilitation training depends heavily on hands-on companionship, emotional support, and human guidance. AI can process data but cannot provide human patience. Documentation is redistributed, while the occupation remains stable.
ai_s3_list: Hands-on companionship: people provide emotional support.
Training adjustments: people identify pain points.
Assistive-device fitting: people test whether devices work.
Patient motivation: people build confidence.
Interdisciplinary feedback: people provide judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation in a medium-to-high-exposure category. Systems accelerate documentation and assessment, but people retain responsibility for training and companionship.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces data entry and scheduling, not helping people recover. Patient assistants who build trust become even scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in rehabilitation / nursing and earn qualifications early. Pure documentation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop hands-on ability.
Advance from recording data to leading training and providing feedback, and learn to collaborate with rehabilitation robots.
Highlight patience and hands-on cases. Organizations value steadiness and resilience through repetition.
Do not assess candidates solely by certificates; determine whether they understand companionship and remain emotionally stable.

ai_s7_trends: Rehabilitation demand rises with population aging.
Robot collaboration becomes standard.
Assistants with strong companionship skills are more sought after.

body: Occupational therapy assistants work under occupational therapists to help patients recover daily activities and occupational abilities, improving function through movement training, assistive devices, and adaptive-living exercises.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Rehabilitation robots can assist movement practice, but assistants still support patients through emotional setbacks and repetition and adapt training to each person.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 康复机器人能辅助练动作，但陪患者走过情绪和反复、把训练调到人身上，还是助理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年作业治疗助理在岗约 4.92 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.87 万人，净增约 0.95 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.72 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.83 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代作业治疗助理，只会在记录和评估上帮忙。康复训练高度依赖手把手陪伴、情绪接住和人工引导，AI 接得住数据，接不住人的耐心。被分流的是文书，岗位本身稳。
ai_s3_list: 手把手陪伴：情绪靠人接。
训练微调：痛点靠人摸。
辅助器具适配：合用靠人试。
患者激励：信心靠人给。
跨科反馈：判断靠人写。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——文书和评估被系统加速，但训练与陪伴还牢牢留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「记数据和排表」动作，不是「陪人康复」的岗位。有耐心、能和患者建立信任的助理，反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 康复/护理起步，早点考资质，AI 时代纯文书在缩，多练实操。
从「记数据」升级成「带训练和做反馈」，学康复机器人协同。
突出耐心和实操案例，机构看重稳和能扛反复。
选人别只看证书，要看有没有陪伴脑子和情绪稳定。

ai_s7_trends: 康复需求随老龄上升。
机器人协同成标配。
有陪伴力的助理更抢手。

body: 作业治疗助理在作业治疗师督导下，协助患者恢复日常活动与职业能力，通过动作训练、辅助器具和生活适应练习改善功能。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 康复机器人能辅助练动作，但陪患者走过情绪和反复、把训练调到人身上，还是助理定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated dispensing cabinets can retrieve medications, but technicians still decide how to verify prescriptions, answer questions, and manage special drugs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 490,400 pharmacy technicians were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 521,800, a net increase of about 31,400 jobs, with about 49,000 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $43,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pharmacy technicians, but it will take over standard dispensing. Automated dispensing and system verification accelerate routine medication retrieval, shifting technicians from picking medications toward verification, patient communication, and inventory management. Pure dispensing faces displacement, while people who verify accurately and provide service remain more secure.
ai_s3_list: Verification: people ensure zero errors.
Patient communication: people answer questions.
Special-drug management: people ensure compliance.
Field judgment: people investigate anomalies.
Medication guidance: people provide compassionate service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 indicates moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate standard dispensing, but people remain essential for verification and service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Retrieving standard medications is being replaced, not verification and patient-service roles. Qualified people who provide service become scarcer as productivity improves. Technicians who only retrieve medications are vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: People entering from pharmaceutical fields should develop system proficiency and attention to detail. Pure dispensing is shrinking in the AI era, so practice verification early.
Advance from medication retrieval to verification + service, and study pharmacology and communication.
Highlight credentials and a zero-error record. Pharmacies value steadiness and accuracy.
Do not assess candidates only by speed. Evaluate attention to detail and compliance awareness, and place strong performers at patient-facing windows.

ai_s7_trends: Automated dispensing becomes widespread, reducing manual dispensing.
Verification and service create opportunities.
Technicians who provide service remain more secure.

body: Pharmacy technicians lead medication receipt and dispensing, verification, and preparation assistance. They coordinate prescriptions, inventory, and systems and use verification and communication skills to ensure accurate dispensing and serve patients.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated dispensing cabinets can retrieve medications, but technicians still decide how to verify prescriptions, answer questions, and manage special drugs.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动发药柜能抓药，但处方怎么核、疑问怎么答、特殊药怎么管，还是技术员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年药房技术员在岗约 49.04 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 52.18 万人，净增约 3.14 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.90 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.35 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代药房技术员，但会接管标准调剂。自动发药与系统核对把常规抓药提速，技术员从「抓药」挪向「核对把关、患者沟通、库存管理」。真正被挤掉的是纯调剂，懂核对、能服务的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 核对把关：零差错靠人。
患者沟通：疑问靠人答。
特殊药管理：合规靠人。
现场判断：异常靠人。
用药引导：态度靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——标准调剂被系统加速，但核对与服务还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「抓标准药」动作，不是「核对把关与患者服务」的岗位。有资质、能服务的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会抓药的技术员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医药相关起步多练系统和细心，AI 时代纯调剂在缩，早点练核对。
从「抓药」升级成「核对 + 服务」，学药理与沟通。
突出资质与零差错记录，药店看重稳和准。
选人别只看快，看细心和合规意识，骨干值得给窗口岗。

ai_s7_trends: 自动发药普及，调剂缩。
核对与服务带来机会。
能服务的技术员更稳。

body: 药房技术员主导药品的收发、核对与调配辅助，统筹处方、库存与系统，运用核对与沟通手段，保障发药准确并服务患者。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动发药柜能抓药，但处方怎么核、疑问怎么答、特殊药怎么管，还是技术员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can locate incidents and dispatch automatically, but dispatchers still decide how to question callers, calm them, and coordinate multiple responders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 105,200 public safety telecommunicators were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 108,900, a net increase of about 3,700 jobs, with about 10,700 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $50,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace dispatchers, but it will accelerate dispatching. Intelligent location and automated assignment speed routine incidents, shifting dispatchers from issuing assignments toward assessment, reassurance, multi-agency coordination, and major-incident response. Pure dispatching faces displacement, while people with assessment and coordination skills are more resilient.
ai_s3_list: Assessment and reassurance: people stabilize emotions.
Multi-party coordination: people balance interests.
Major-incident response: people make trade-offs.
Information verification: people investigate doubts.
Field coordination: people control the pace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. Systems accelerate parts of the work, while positions remain where people must judge and provide final safeguards.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Assigning standard incidents faces replacement, not assessment, reassurance, and multi-agency coordination. People with strong judgment and coordination become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in communications or emergency management and practice judgment and resilience. Pure dispatching is shrinking in the AI era, so develop coordination early.
Advance from dispatching to assessment + coordination, and learn response plans and communication.
Highlight an error-free dispatch record and resilience. Centers value composure and speed.
When hiring, assess composure and coordination, not speed alone. Strong personnel deserve responsibility for major incidents.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent dispatching spreads, reducing standard dispatch work.
Assessment and coordination create opportunities.
Dispatchers with incident-response skills are more resilient.

body: Public safety telecommunicators receive and dispatch police, fire, and emergency medical incidents, coordinating information, location, and resources through systems and communication techniques and mobilizing multiple agencies to complete the response.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can locate incidents and dispatch automatically, but dispatchers still decide how to question callers, calm them, and coordinate multiple responders.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动定位派单，但怎么问、怎么稳、多方怎么调，还是调度员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年公共安全通信调度员在岗约 10.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.89 万人，净增约 0.37 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.07 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代调度员，但会加速派单。智能定位与自动派单把常规警情提速，调度员从「派单」挪向「研判安抚、多方协调、大警处置」。真正被挤掉的是纯派单，懂研判、能协调的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 研判安抚：情绪靠人稳。
多方协调：利益靠人。
大警处置：取舍靠人。
信息核实：疑点靠人。
现场联动：节奏靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「派标准单」动作，不是「研判安抚与多方协调」的岗位。有研判力、能协调的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 通信/应急起步多练研判和抗压，AI 时代纯派单在缩，早点练协调。
从「派单」升级成「研判 + 协调」，学预案与沟通。
突出零误派与抗压，中心看重稳和快。
选人别只看快，看沉稳和协调，骨干值得给大警。

ai_s7_trends: 智能派单普及，派单缩。
研判协调带来机会。
能处置的调度更稳。

body: 公共安全通信调度员主导警情消防急救的接报与调度，统筹信息、定位与资源，运用系统与话术手段，派单并协调多方处置落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动定位派单，但怎么问、怎么稳、多方怎么调，还是调度员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can read three months of your literature in three seconds, but a political scientist still has to decide whether the question is worth asking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 6,500 political scientists were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 6,300 by 2034, a net decrease of about 200 jobs, with approximately 500 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $139,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace political scientists, but it will restructure the research process. Once AI handles literature searches, data cleaning, and text summaries, scholars can shift from reading literature to posing questions, building theories, and making policy judgments. The truly scarce skill is asking good questions and finding causal relationships in ambiguous political phenomena.
ai_s2_accel: Large-model assistance in generating research hypotheses and literature review drafts
Automatic identification of sentiment and topics in text
Rapid literature reviews of policy effects
Automatic translation and comparison of multilingual political materials
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent search and summarization of extensive literature and policy texts
Structured coding of political texts and news
Automatic cleaning of election and public opinion data
Automatic management of references and citations
ai_s3_list: Research design: deciding which questions are worth asking and how to test them.
Theory building: explaining phenomena through causal mechanisms.
Policy judgment: translating evidence into decisions.
Cross-domain synthesis: integrating politics, economics, and history.
Public communication: explaining scholarship to decision-makers and the public.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates that this career has moderately high exposure in text and data work. AI can accelerate searches, cleaning, and summaries, but humans still formulate questions and theories.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: AI replaces reading and excerpting, not thinking and judging. Political scientists who ask strong questions and make policy judgments become more valuable. Junior research assistants who only compile literature face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in political science and learn statistics and programming early. In the AI era, research design and policy judgment matter more than memorizing theories.
Master AI literature tools and statistical libraries, and strengthen policy and communication skills. Upgrade from writing papers to providing consulting to broaden your options.
Highlight the research you have conducted, what you have published, and whom you have advised. Quantitative methods and demonstrated policy outcomes are advantages.
Hiring should assess awareness of important questions and the ability to translate research into policy, not just credentials. Researchers who can independently produce briefs deserve premium pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Full-text search of papers and policies
Retrieval from election and public opinion databases
Search of regulations and white papers

ai_s7_trends: Demand for policy consulting and international relations analysis remains steady, and think-tank roles are expanding.
AI literature and text tools are becoming widespread, reducing junior research roles focused on retrieval.
Hybrid scholars who combine quantitative skills with policy translation are increasingly scarce.

body: Political scientists study governments, political institutions, public policy, and international relations. They use quantitative and qualitative methods to analyze political behavior and policy outcomes and produce academic research, policy analysis, and consulting for universities, think tanks, governments, and international organizations.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can read three months of your literature in three seconds, but a political scientist still has to decide whether the question is worth asking.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在三秒里读完你三个月的文献，但「这个问题值不值得问」，还得政治学家拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年政治学家在岗约 0.65 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.63 万人，岗位净减约 0.02 万个，年均产生约 0.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.94 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代政治学家，但会重构研究流程。文献检索、数据清洗、文本摘要交给 AI 后，学者从「读文献」挪向「提问题、建理论、做政策判断」。真正稀缺的是能提出好问题、在模糊政治现象里找因果的人。
ai_s2_accel: 大模型辅助生成研究假设与文献综述草稿
文本情感与议题的自动识别
政策效果的快速文献综览
多语种政治资料的自动翻译比对
ai_s2_auto: 海量文献与政策文本的智能检索摘要
政治文本与新闻的结构化编码
选举与民意数据的自动清洗
参考文献与 citation 的自动管理
ai_s3_list: 研究设计：什么问题值得问、怎么验证。
理论建构：把现象讲成因果机制。
政策判断：证据怎么落到决策。
跨域综合：把政治、经济、历史拧一起。
公共沟通：把学术讲给决策者和公众。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的文本与数据区——检索、清洗、摘要都能被加速，但提问和理论仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「读和摘」，不是「想和判」。会提问题、能做政策判断的政治学家更稀缺。怕的是只做文献搬运的初级研究助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 政治学打底，尽早学统计和编程。AI 时代拼的是研究设计与政策判断，别只背理论。
把 AI 文献工具和统计库用熟，补政策与沟通能力。从「写论文」升级成「做咨询」，路更宽。
突出你做过什么研究、发过什么、给谁做过咨询。有量化方法和政策成果优先。
招人看问题意识和政策转化力，不止看学历。能独立出简报的研究员值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 政策咨询与国际关系分析需求稳，智库岗扩张。
AI 文献与文本工具普及，初级检索岗被压缩。
会量化又会政策转化的复合学者更稀缺。

body: 政治学家研究政府、政治制度、公共政策与国际关系，运用定量与质性方法分析政治行为与政策结果，在高校、智库、政府和国际组织产出学术研究、政策分析与咨询。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能在三秒里读完你三个月的文献，但「这个问题值不值得问」，还得政治学家拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Algorithms can monitor cameras and logs, but people still decide whether an alert is real or false and whether to dispatch responders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,205,700 security management specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 1,242,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 36,300 jobs, with approximately 108,200 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $81,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace security management specialists, but it will take over routine monitoring. Once systems handle video analysis, log correlation, and alert triage, specialists shift from watching screens to risk assessment, emergency-plan design, and on-site response. People who set direction during incidents and take responsibility for outcomes are truly scarce.
ai_s2_accel: Online organization of training and drills
ai_s2_auto: Smart video analysis and anomaly detection
Automated correlation of access-control data and logs
ai_s3_list: On-site response: people decide how to handle incidents.
Risk judgment: people distinguish false alarms from real ones.
Emergency-plan design: people adapt plans to each organization.
Cross-department coordination: connect security, IT, and administration.
Ultimate accountability: people take responsibility when incidents occur.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates medium AI exposure in security. Automation handles monitoring and triage, but people retain an essential role in assessment and response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high overall risk. Screen watching is what gets replaced, not the position itself. Specialists who can analyze, respond, and take responsibility become even scarcer. Those who only provide mechanical surveillance and do not learn new systems face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in security or fire safety and earn registered safety or fire-protection credentials while in school. Pure monitoring is shrinking in the AI era, so develop risk-assessment and response skills early.
Advance from guarding to risk management. Learn analysis and emergency planning and pursue a Security Manager role rather than remaining in surveillance.
Highlight attention to detail and response experience, and specify the incidents you have handled. Credentials and cross-department experience are preferred.
Hire for risk awareness and response capability, not only physical fitness. Specialists who independently design emergency plans and take responsibility are worth premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: Video and log analysis continue to automate, reducing monitoring roles.
Models are beginning to support risk scoring and emergency simulations.
Multidisciplinary security talent skilled in analysis and response is in greater demand.

body: Security Management Specialists identify and control risks to an organization's people, assets, and information. They establish security systems and emergency plans, organize hazard inspections and drills, respond to incidents, and protect operational continuity and compliance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Algorithms can monitor cameras and logs, but people still decide whether an alert is real or false and whether to dispatch responders.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监控和日志能交给算法，但「这报警是真还是误报、要不要派人」，还得人判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年安全管理专员在岗约 120.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 124.20 万人，净增约 3.63 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.82 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.13 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代安全管理专员，但会接管值守。视频分析、日志关联、告警分诊交给系统后，专员从「盯屏幕」挪向「风险评估、预案设计与现场处置」。真正稀缺的是能在事件里定方向、为结果担责的人。
ai_s2_accel: 培训与演练的在线组织
ai_s2_auto: 视频智能分析与异常识别
门禁与日志的自动关联
告警的自动分诊与去重
ai_s3_list: 现场处置：事件靠人到场定。
风险判断：误报真报靠人辨。
预案设计：组织差异靠人定。
跨部门协调：安保IT行政串起来。
责任兜底：出事要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的安防区——值守与分诊被自动化，但评估与处置还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于整体高风险：被替代的是「盯屏值守」，不是「岗位」。会分析会处置、能扛责的专员反而更稀缺。怕的是只做机械看守、不学新系统的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 安保消防类打底，在校把注册安全/消防证考了。AI 时代纯值守在缩，早点练风险评估和处置。
从「看守」升级成「风险管理」，学分析和预案，争取转安全经理，别停留在盯监控。
突出细心和处置经验，写清处理过哪些事件。有证和跨部门经验优先。
招人看风险意识和处置力，不止看体格。能独立定预案、敢担责的专员值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 视频与日志分析持续自动化，值守岗收缩。
风险评分与应急推演开始用模型。
会分析会处置的复合安全人才更抢手。

body: 安全管理专员识别并管控组织面临的人员、资产与信息安全风险，建立安防制度与应急预案，组织隐患排查与演练，处置安全事件，保障运营连续与合规。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 监控和日志能交给算法，但「这报警是真还是误报、要不要派人」，还得人判断。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automate noise reduction and rough mixes, but human ears still decide whether a vocal should sound warmer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 16,900 sound engineering technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 16,600 by 2034, a net loss of about 300 jobs, with approximately 1,200 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $66,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace sound engineering technicians, but it will accelerate studio processes. When AI handles noise reduction, audio restoration, and automated mixing, technicians shift from fixing flaws to artistic judgment and live sound reinforcement. People with excellent ears who shape sound aesthetically are truly scarce.
ai_s2_auto: Automated audio noise reduction and restoration
Automated rough mixing and level matching
Automated enhancement of speech and dialogue clarity
Automated organization and labeling of audio assets
ai_s3_list: Listening aesthetics: determine whether sound should be warm or bright.
Live sound reinforcement: manage performances in real time.
Artistic judgment: realize the artist's intent.
Acoustic setup: position microphones for the environment.
Collaboration and communication: align with directors and artists.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates medium-high AI exposure in audio processing. Noise reduction, restoration, and rough mixing all accelerate, but listening judgment and live work remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. Repair work and rough mixing get replaced, not artistic and live responsibilities. Technicians with excellent ears and live sound skills become scarcer. Entry-level roles limited to noise reduction and restoration face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in audio and develop a strong portfolio while in school. In the AI era, listening judgment and live skills matter more than restoration work alone.
Master AI noise-reduction and mixing tools and add live sound reinforcement. Advance from studio-only work to live + mastering for a clearer premium.
Do not only state software proficiency. Show what you have mixed and the live problems you have solved. Portfolios receive priority.
Hire for listening ability and live performance, not only software skills. Technicians who independently mix and reinforce sound are worth premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: Streaming and short-form video drive audio demand.
AI noise-reduction and mixing are spreading, reducing basic studio roles.
Multidisciplinary technicians skilled in live sound and mastering are scarcer.

body: Sound Engineering Technicians record, provide live sound reinforcement, mix, and master audio in studios, performance venues, and film and broadcasting organizations. They operate consoles and audio software to protect technical quality and artistic presentation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can automate noise reduction and rough mixes, but human ears still decide whether a vocal should sound warmer.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把降噪和粗混做成自动，但「这段人声该不该再暖一点」，还得耳朵定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术员工程在岗约 1.69 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.66 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.12 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.64 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代音响工程技师，但会加速棚内工序。降噪、音频修复和自动混音交给 AI 后，技师从「修瑕疵」挪向「做艺术判断、管现场扩声」。真正稀缺的是有好耳朵、能把声音做出审美的人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助混音建议与预设
ai_s2_auto: 音频降噪与修复的自动处理
粗混与电平匹配的自动化
语音与对话的自动清晰化
音频素材的自动整理标注
ai_s3_list: 听感审美：声音该暖该亮。
现场扩声：演出实时把控。
艺术判断：实现艺人意图。
声学布置：话筒与环境。
协作沟通：和导演艺人对齐。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的音频处理区——降噪、修复、粗混都能被加速，但听感和现场仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「修和粗混」，不是「艺术和现场」。有好耳朵、能做现场扩声的技师更稀缺。怕的是只做降噪修复的初级岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 音频专业打底，在校多混作品集。AI 时代拼听感与现场，别只当修复员。
把 AI 降噪混音工具用熟，补现场扩声。从「棚内」升级成「现场 + 母带」，溢价更明显。
别只写「会用软件」，亮出你混过什么、现场救过什么。有作品优先。
招人看耳朵和现场力，不止看软件。能独立混音扩声的技师值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 流媒体与短视频拉动音频需求。
AI 降噪混音普及，棚内基础岗压缩。
会现场扩声与母带的复合技师更稀缺。

body: 音响工程技师在录音棚、演出与影视广播机构负责录音、现场扩声、混音与母带处理，操作调音台与音频软件，保障声音的技术质量与艺术呈现。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把降噪和粗混做成自动，但「这段人声该不该再暖一点」，还得耳朵定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated mapping can assemble the map, but surveyors still decide which land to measure, how to establish boundaries, and whether the results are accurate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 56,100 surveyors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 58,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,500 jobs, with approximately 3,900 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $72,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace surveyors, but it will reduce field roles. Drones and automated mapping accelerate routine data collection, shifting surveyors from visiting points toward survey design, property-rights review, deliverable quality, and project management. Basic drafting faces displacement, while professionals who can maintain control become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Property-rights review: People resolve disputes.
Survey design: People define the survey area.
Deliverable quality: People provide the final signature.
Field verification: People investigate anomalies.
Client coordination: People resolve disagreements.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderately high AI exposure. Systems accelerate fieldwork and drafting, but people retain responsibility for property rights and quality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces basic drafting tasks, not accountability for deliverables. Professionals who can maintain control and define plans become scarcer as efficiency improves. The real risk is knowing only how to visit points and draw maps.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with surveying, mapping, or engineering and practice extensively with instruments and coordinates. Basic drafting is shrinking in the AI era, so develop quality-control skills early.
Advance from visiting points to designing plans + managing quality, and pursue registered surveyor credentials.
Highlight project and instrument experience, and specify which engineering projects you have supported.
Do not select candidates solely for instrument fluency. Evaluate whether they can define plans and take responsibility for quality.

ai_s7_trends: Automated mapping spreads, reducing fieldwork.
Real estate and urban renewal create opportunities.
Professionals with strong oversight capabilities are in greater demand.

body: Surveyors lead land, engineering, and hydrographic surveys. They establish boundaries, control points, and elevations and use GNSS, total stations, and mapping software to produce deliverable survey results.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated mapping can assemble the map, but surveyors still decide which land to measure, how to establish boundaries, and whether the results are accurate.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动成图能拼图，但哪块地要测、边界怎么定、成果准不准，还是测量师拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年测量师在岗约 5.61 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.86 万人，净增约 0.25 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代测量师，但会压缩外业岗。无人机与自动成图把常规采集提速，测量师从「跑点」挪向「方案设计、权属把关、成果质量、项目管理」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础绘图的，有把控力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 权属把关：争议靠人断。
方案设计：测区靠人定。
成果质量：签字靠人。
现场复核：异常靠人。
客户协调：争执靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——外业与绘图被系统加速，但权属与质量还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「基础绘图」动作，不是「成果把关」的岗位。有把控力、能定方案的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑点画图的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 测绘/工程起步多练仪器和坐标，AI 时代纯绘图在缩，早点练把关。
从「跑点」升级成「做方案 + 管质量」，考注册测绘师。
突出项目与仪器经验，写清跟过哪些工程。
选人别只看手熟，要看会不会定方案和担质量。

ai_s7_trends: 自动成图普及，外业缩。
不动产与城市更新带来机会。
有把控力的人更抢手。

body: 测量师主导土地、工程与水下测量，确立边界、控制点与高程，运用 GNSS、全站仪与成图软件产出可交付的测绘成果。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动成图能拼图，但哪块地要测、边界怎么定、成果准不准，还是测量师拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can screen one hundred thousand resumes for people who look like a character, but only a person can judge whether an actor's performance will move the audience to tears.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 167,000 casting and talent directors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 175,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,200 jobs, with about 12,800 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $83,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace casting and talent directors, but it will take over open calls. Profile screening, appearance matching, and audition-tape distribution can all be automated. Value shifts toward final judgment, network coordination, and trusted relationships. A major director does not want the person who looks most similar, but the person who is truly right for the role. That judgment depends on human taste and credibility.
ai_s2_accel: AI audition-tape analysis supports evaluation of performance dimensions
Online casting platforms expand candidate reach
Big-data analysis of actor popularity and market rates
AI-generated character profiles support requirements communication
ai_s2_auto: Automatically organize actor resumes and portfolios in a database
Initial AI matching of physical characteristics to character profiles
Automated distribution and comparison of audition videos
Automated coordination of availability and schedules
ai_s3_list: On-site judgment: recognize within minutes in an audition room whether someone has the necessary presence.
Network trust: inspire directors, agents, and actors to entrust projects to you.
Negotiation and coordination: balance schedules, budgets, and compensation.
Industry instinct: know which newcomers are rising and which genres are gaining momentum.
Risk ownership: champion a candidate against objections and accept the consequences of a mistaken judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 means the front end of casting is highly data-driven. AI and platforms greatly accelerate resume screening, appearance matching, and material distribution. But AI participation falls as work moves toward final judgment, network coordination, and trusted endorsement, which form the director's core value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure can be beneficial. AI makes open calls less expensive, encouraging projects to cast a wider net and increasing the value of directors with judgment and strong networks. Give initial screening to tools and spend time evaluating people, negotiating, and making projects happen; the career ceiling becomes higher.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter this field, accept that internships provide entry and projects create advancement; education is not decisive. Participate in campus theater and short-film productions during college because they build judgment more effectively than classes alone. If your family has no industry connections, prepare for modest income during the first few years.

Digitize the actor database and learn AI screening tools to free yourself from resume review. Maintain core industry relationships and consider expanding into production to become more resilient to project volatility.

People with HR, talent agency, or acting backgrounds have an advantage in transitioning. Begin as a casting assistant and build case experience before taking independent projects. In interviews, demonstrate knowledge of the market for a specific actor category rather than speaking in generalities.

When hiring for casting roles, emphasize project credits and teams worked with rather than resume length. Use AI tools to reduce the burden on execution roles and direct the budget toward core people who bring resources and can make accountable judgments.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Search global actor profiles with one click
Filter candidates in batches according to character profiles
Automatic alerts for scheduling conflicts across parties
Centralized management of credits, rates, and availability
Convert character descriptions into screening criteria
Online auditions for actors in other locations
Track actor popularity and industry trends

ai_s7_trends: Online casting and AI initial screening become widespread, greatly improving open-call efficiency and shifting directors toward final selection and negotiation.
Rapid growth in short dramas, web series, and advertising creates substantial low- and mid-budget casting demand and a clear talent-pipeline gap.
Combining data-driven sourcing with human final selection concentrates industry influence among leading casting directors.

body: Talent directors match appropriate actors to film, advertising, performance, and other projects. They lead character analysis, actor screening, auditions, and schedule coordination while managing talent resources and commercial partnerships.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can screen one hundred thousand resumes for people who look like a character, but only a person can judge whether an actor's performance will move the audience to tears.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能从十万份简历里筛出「长得像角色」的人，但「他演这场戏会不会让观众落泪」，只有人判断得了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年选角与艺人总监在岗约 16.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.52 万人，净增约 0.82 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.35 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代选角与艺人总监，但会接管「海选」：资料筛选、外形匹配、试镜带分发都能自动化。真正的价值转移到了终审判断、人脉协调和信任关系上——大导演要的不是「最像的人」，是「最对的人」，这个「对」字背后是人的眼光和信誉。
ai_s2_accel: AI 试镜带分析辅助评估表演维度
线上选角平台扩大候选人触达范围
大数据分析演员市场热度与价位
AI 生成角色画像辅助需求沟通
ai_s2_auto: 演员简历与作品资料自动入库整理
AI 外形特征与角色画像初步匹配
试镜视频的自动分发与比对
档期与日程的自动化协调
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：试镜室里几分钟内看出「有没有戏」。
人脉信任：让导演、经纪、演员都愿意把项目托付给你。
谈判协调：在档期、预算、片酬之间找出平衡。
行业嗅觉：知道哪位新人正在崛起、哪个类型在热。
风险担责：力排众议推荐人选，也要敢承担看走眼的后果。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明选角行业的前端流程高度数据化：简历筛选、外形匹配、资料分发都被 AI 和平台大幅提速。但越往后端——终审判断、人脉协调、信任背书——AI 的参与度越低，这些正是总监的核心价值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不一定是坏事：AI 把「海选」变便宜了，项目方更愿意广撒网，反而放大了「会判断、有人脉」的总监的价值。把初筛交给工具，把时间花在看人、谈人、成事上，职业天花板只会更高。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这行先接受「入行靠实习、出头靠项目」的现实，学历不是决定性因素。大学多参与校园剧社、短片拍摄，比上课更能积累判断力；家里没有行业资源的话，做好前几年收入不高的心理准备。
把演员资料库数字化、学会用 AI 初筛工具，把自己从「筛简历」里解放出来。同时维护好核心人脉，尝试往制片方向延伸，抗项目波动能力会更强。
有 HR、经纪人、表演背景的人转型有优势。先从选角助理做起积累案例，别一上来就想独立接项目；面试时展示你对某个类型演员市场的了解，比泛泛而谈更打动人。
选角岗位招人重点看「作品清单 + 合作过的团队」而非简历字数。用 AI 工具降低执行岗负荷，把预算花在能带资源、能扛判断的核心人选身上。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 全球演员资料一键检索
多方档期冲突自动提醒
作品、价位、档期集中管理
把角色描述转成筛选条件
演员热度与行业趋势追踪

ai_s7_trends: 线上选角与 AI 初筛普及，海选环节大幅提效，总监重心转向终审与谈判。
短剧、网剧、广告的爆发带来大量中低预算选角需求，人才梯队缺口明显。
「数据选人 + 眼光定人」结合，选角总监的行业话语权向头部集中。

body: 选角与艺人总监负责为影视、广告、演出等项目匹配合适演员，主导角色分析、演员筛选、试镜组织与档期协调，同时管理艺人资源与商务合作。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能从十万份简历里筛出「长得像角色」的人，但「他演这场戏会不会让观众落泪」，只有人判断得了。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify anomalous data, but an inspector's eyes and hands are still needed beneath the vehicle to confirm which component must be replaced.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 25,700 transportation equipment and systems inspectors, excluding aviation, were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 26,100 by 2034, a net gain of about 400 jobs, with about 2,500 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $85,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace transportation equipment and systems inspectors, but it will change inspection methods. AI takes over inspection-data records, scheduling, and initial screening of sensor anomalies, shifting inspectors from visual scanning toward reviewing AI alerts and confirming hazards on site. Critical-system judgment, response to sudden faults, and signed accountability remain irreplaceable. People, not algorithms, are held responsible when accidents occur.
ai_s2_accel: AI image recognition for surface-damage inspection
Pilot drone inspections of tracks and large equipment
Real-time fault codes from onboard diagnostic systems
Predictive maintenance replacing scheduled teardown inspections
ai_s2_auto: Digital inspection records and automated scheduling management
Automatic sensor-data collection and anomaly tagging
Automated alerts for wheelsets, brakes, and other conditions
Closed-loop maintenance work orders and hazard tracking
ai_s3_list: On-site judgment of critical systems: An alarm does not prove a fault; people must inspect it directly.
Assessing hazard severity: Inspectors decide what can remain in service and what must stop, with serious consequences for mistakes.
Real-time response to sudden faults: Experience and composure guide on-site action under emergency procedures.
Communication with maintenance and dispatch departments: People communicate inspection conclusions and close the loop.
Signed accountability: Inspectors endorse conclusions and bear responsibility that AI cannot assume.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means inspection records and initial screening are becoming automated. Systems handle data collection, anomaly tagging, and scheduling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. More precise monitoring requires inspectors to review findings and respond more effectively, increasing the importance of on-site judgment and hazard closure. Repetitive visual inspection faces the greatest pressure, while versatile inspectors who analyze data and use testing equipment become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study vehicle engineering, rail vehicles, electromechanics, or transportation. Entry through railway administrations or large transportation companies is common. Accumulate credentials and internships while in school because railway recruitment imposes strict professional and education requirements.

Become proficient with sensor data and predictive-maintenance systems and volunteer for equipment-data analysis. Advance from inspection toward diagnosis and closed-loop resolution, then pursue team-lead or technical-management roles.

Career changers with mechanical, vehicle, or maintenance backgrounds adapt quickly and can enter through testing organizations or logistics-fleet inspection roles. On resumes, specify equipment inspected, typical hazards found, and credentials held.

Do not hire inspectors based only on seniority. Assess system proficiency and hazard-assessment reasoning. People who use AI inspection tools and locate problems quickly deserve focused development over checklist-only workers.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time wheelset and brake data collection
Automatic damage annotation and trend analysis
Scheduling, records, and closed-loop hazard management
Inspection of tracks, bridges, and large equipment
Dimension, pressure, insulation, and related measurements
On-site checklists, photographs, audit trails, and immediate reporting

ai_s7_trends: Sensors and AI diagnostics are becoming standard, shifting inspection from scheduled human checks toward condition monitoring plus on-site review. Inspectors become decision-makers supported by data.
Vehicle electrification and intelligence create new inspection requirements, increasing demand for versatile inspectors who understand electricity and data.
With zero tolerance for safety hazards, overall demand remains stable, and signed accountability and professional skill continue to form the occupation's moat.

body: Transportation equipment and systems inspectors, except aviation, perform pre-operation and periodic inspections of rail vehicles, road transportation equipment, and construction machinery. They troubleshoot faults, conduct safety inspections, and sign records as professional technical inspectors in transportation and equipment safety systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can identify anomalous data, but an inspector's eyes and hands are still needed beneath the vehicle to confirm which component must be replaced.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你筛出异常数据，但钻到车底确认「就是这个部件要换」，还得是检查员的眼睛和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运输、设备系统检查员、航空在岗约 2.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.61 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代运输设备系统检查员，但会改变检查方式。检测数据记录、检查排程、传感器异常初筛都被 AI 接手，检查员从「人眼扫查」转向「复核 AI 提示、现场确认隐患」。真正不可替代的是关键系统的现场判断、突发故障处置，以及签字担责——出事了追责的是人，不是算法。
ai_s2_accel: AI 图像识别辅助检查表面损伤
无人机巡检轨道与大型设备试点
车载诊断系统实时推送故障码
预测性维护分析替代定期拆检
ai_s2_auto: 检查记录电子化与排程自动管理
传感器数据自动采集与异常标记
轮对、制动等状态监测自动告警
维修工单与隐患跟踪闭环
ai_s3_list: 关键系统的现场判断：数据报了警，是不是真有问题，要蹲下去看。
隐患的轻重权衡：哪些能放、哪些必须停，判断错了后果严重。
突发故障的临场处置：现场按预案处置，靠的是经验和镇定。
与维修和调度部门的沟通：检查结论怎么传达、怎么闭环，靠人。
签字责任：检验结论由检查员背书，这份责任 AI 扛不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的检测记录与初筛工作正被自动化——数据采集、异常标记、排程都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为监测更精准，检查员被要求「更会复核、更会处置」，现场判断和隐患闭环反而更重要。真正被挤压的是纯肉眼重复检查环节，会数据分析、懂检测设备的复合型检查员更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读车辆工程、铁道车辆、机电或运输相关专业，进铁路局或大型运输企业是主流路径。在校就把技能证书和实习攒起来，铁路系统招聘对专业和学历卡得严。
把传感器数据、预测性维护系统用熟，主动接设备数据分析的活。从「会检查」升级为「懂诊断、能闭环」，向班组长或技术管理走。
有机械、车辆或维修背景的转行者上手快，从检测机构或物流车队的检查岗切入。简历上多写「检查过哪些设备、发现过哪些典型隐患、持有哪些证书」。
招检查员别只看资历，要看系统使用能力和隐患判断思路。会用 AI 检测工具、能快速定位问题的人，比只会按表打勾的更值得培养。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 轮对、制动实时数据采集
损伤自动标注、趋势分析
轨道、桥梁、大型设备巡检
现场勾选、拍照留痕、即时上报

ai_s7_trends: 传感器与 AI 诊断成为标配，检查从「定期人检」转向「状态监测 + 现场复核」，检查员变成数据辅助下的决策者。
车辆电气化与智能化带来新检查项目，懂电气和数据的复合型检查员需求上升。
安全隐患零容忍的大背景下，岗位需求总体稳定，签字责任与专业技能依然是护城河。

body: 运输、设备系统检查员（除航空外）负责对铁路车辆、公路运输工具与工程设备进行运行前与定期检查，执行故障排查、安全检验与记录签署，是运输与设备安全体系中的专业技。
